entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 328636019723252096: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 8.2238 +/- 0.0327 mas (same row, RUWE 1.00): 121.60 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -0.977, -8.895 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 1.444 +/- 0.034 solar radii from Chakrabarty & Sengupta 2019, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-33 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158...39C/abstract). Mass 1.495 +/- 0.031 solar masses from Chakrabarty & Sengupta 2019, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-33 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158...39C/abstract). Temperature 7430 +/- 100 K from Chakrabarty & Sengupta 2019, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-33 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 7,430 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: HD 15082 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ecedff. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: HD 15082 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 7,430 K and log g 4.29 (u1 0.280, u2 0.347): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
